title: A Stranger Texted Me: “Don't Go Home Tonight.”
hook: A random number texted me: "Don't go home tonight."
story: A random number texted me: "Don't go home tonight. Trust me." I figured it was a wrong number, so I replied, "Who is this?" They sent back a photo. Of my front door. Taken from across the street. I called the police and stayed at my friend's place. Around midnight, an officer called me back. My front door was wide open. Nothing was stolen. But someone had been inside, and they'd left every light off and every window locked, and they were still in my closet when the police walked in. The officer asked if I had any idea who sent the text. I didn't. So I texted the number one more time: "Thank you. Who ARE you?" The reply came back instantly. "I live across the street. I saw a man go in with a key an hour before you usually get home. You don't know me, but you wave at me every morning." I'd never really noticed her. Not once. Now I wave every single morning… because a random number texted me: "Don't go home tonight."
description:
Always wave at your neighbors. 🏠
